eps.o: WWE Evolve kicks off its second season with two championship showdowns. Cappucino Jones gets his chance to unseat Jackson Drake as Evolve Champion.
Interim NXT General Manager Robert Stone hosts a town hall to make an important announcement regarding the future of WWE Evolve.
Jackson Drake marks his final night in WWE Evolve by defending the WWE Evolve Championship one last time against first-time challenger Aaron Rourke.
Aaron Rourke kicks off his WWE Evolve Title reign by hosting a Championship Celebration.
Competitors collide in a Fatal 5-Way Match to earn the coveted final entry in the upcoming Womens Evolve Championship Gauntlet Eliminator Match.
Aaron Rourke defends the WWE Evolve Title for the first time against one of WWE ID's newest prospects, Chaz "Starboy" Hall.
Eight competitors battle in the Eliminator Gauntlet Match to crown a new WWE Evolve Women's Champion.
Brooks Jensen has no way to escape from Cappuccino Jones when the rivals are bound together in a Bull Rope Match.
Aaron Rourke faces his toughest test to date in a WWE Evolve Championship Triple Threat Match against Braxton Cole and Harlem Lewis.
WWE Evolve Champion Aaron Rourke addresses the Evolve Universe following an ambush attempt by Kam Hendrix & Harley Riggins.
Karmen Petrovic looks to teach Nikkita Lyons a lesson after she meddled in the Evolve Women's Championship Match.
The rivalry between Tate Wilder and Kam Hendrix comes to a head after months of tormenting each other at the WWE Performance Center.
Aaron Rourke defends the WWE Evolve Title against Tristan Angels. Timothy Thatcher makes an important announcement regarding WWE Evolve.
Tensions rise between The Mog Squad and OG WWE ID competitors as Max Abrams battles Cappuccino Jones. Sloane Jacobs looks to dethrone Wendy Choo.
The ongoing issues between The Mog Squad and OG WWE ID competitors come to a head in Six-Man Tag Team Match. Karmen Petrovic duels PJ Vasa.
Romeo Moreno recruits Noam Dar as his partner to even the odds against Harley Riggins & Kam Hendrix.
On WWE Evolve's biggest stage, both championships are on the line when Wendy Choo and Aaron Rourke face their toughest challengers yet.
The rivalry between OG WWE ID and The Mog Squad escalates with a Six-Man Tag Team Elimination Match. KevOnStage takes on Guest GM duties.
Nikkita Lyons begins her reign as WWE Evolve Women's Champion in over-the-top fashion with Big Kat Kita's Championship Celebration.
WWE Evolve Champion Aaron Rourke shows his respect for Harlem Lewis by granting the determined challenger an Evolve Championship opportunity.
Nikkita Lyons makes her first WWE Evolve Women's Title defense in a throwdown with Laynie Luck. WWE Evolve Champion Harlem Lewis sounds off.
NXT standout Tate Wilder returns to WWE Evolve to settle the score with his longtime nemesis Harley Riggins.
Harlem Lewis defends the WWE Evolve Title in a Fatal 4-Way Match against Tristan Angels, Max Abrams and Aaron Rourke.
Evolve standouts It’s GAL, Cappuccino Jones and Chazz "Starboy" Hall aim to impress in a WWE ID Triple Threat Showcase.
Thea Hail puts her devious and dangerous side on full display by challenging Nikkita Lyons for the WWE Evolve Women's Title.
Evolve's first Lumberjack Match ensures Brooks Jensen has nowhere to run in his rematch against Elijah Holyfield.
New No. 1 Contenders for the Men’s and Women’s Evolve Championships emerge when competitors collide in two Fatal 4-Way Matches.
On the WWE ID Showcase Special, the rivalry between WWE ID 1.0 and The Mog Squad culminates with a 4-on-4 Team Gauntlet Series.
After emerging victorious in a Fatal 4-Way Match, the undefeated Cutler James earns the right to challenge Harlem Lewis for the Evolve Championship.
WWE Evolve celebrates its female competitors, as Nikkita Lyons puts the Evolve Women's Championship on the line against challenger Skylar Raye.
Harley Riggins and It's GAL go one-one-one for an opportunity to challenge WWE Evolve Champion Harlem Lewis at Evolve Succession IV.
On the eve of Evolve Succession IV, Aaron Rourke looks to teach Kale Dixon a lesson for his meddling in the 4-on-4 Team Gauntlet Series.
Nikkita Lyons and Harlem Lewis put their respective championships on the line at WWE Evolve's signature showcase.
Aaron Rourke gets a rematch against Kale Dixon and looks for payback after Dixon's recent steel chair attack.
